item.title: OpenClaw is So Fun
item.description: OpenClaw is so fun! The creation and update of this article were all done through bot chat on Feishu. Throughout the process, I only gave various instructions without touching any code, and then let the Agent do the work automatically. It’s foreseeable that more and more work will be taken over by Agents in the future, and the information superhighway will welcome true prosperity.

item.title: Getting Closer
item.description: I’ve been profitable in short-term trading for almost a year now, and I have reason to believe that I’m getting closer and closer to true enlightenment. Next, I need to crystallize these thoughts and experiences in my mind into a trading system, to free up my time and allow myself more time to think and explore new things.

item.title: The Eve of Era Transformation
item.description: We are standing on the eve of a massive era transformation. Every time I think about this, I get incredibly excited. The core element of all this is AI, especially the powerful capabilities of current LLMs. I still position it as a productivity tool, but the capabilities this tool demonstrates are like human intelligence, and in some sense have far exceeded humans. This dimension of transcendence is something that no previous productivity revolution has encountered. What will happen in the future? I’m really looking forward to it.
